ValidationRule.description: Block edits to communication fields once status is "Negotiation Done"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
$Profile.Name<>'System Administrator'
&& $Profile.Name<>'Global Delegated Admin'
&& ISPICKVAL(Indexation_Status__c, "Negotiation Done") && PRIORVALUE(Campaign_Start_Date__c) <> null && PRIORVALUE(Campaign_End_Date__c) <> null && ( ISCHANGED(Communication_Date__c) || ISCHANGED(Means_of_communication__c) || ISCHANGED(Indexation_Amount_Communicated__c) || ISCHANGED(Indexation_Percentage_Communicated__c) || ISCHANGED(Campaign_Start_Date__c) || ISCHANGED(Campaign_End_Date__c) || ISCHANGED(Indexation_Percentage_Targeted__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot modify fields already filled before "Negotiation Done".
